column1: # Limoniter in Italian. Each line: the English, a tab, then the Italian. \n is a new line, \t a tab and \\ a backslash.
# Placeholders in braces ({name}, {}, {:04X}) stay exactly as they are, in whatever order reads well; unnamed {} stay in their order.

! name: and //! about: describe it, //! command: Its title = function adds a command, and //! on_open:, //! on_save:, //! on_send: or //! on_run: function names what runs when. In on_send, send_device() names the device and set_send_name("NAME") changes the name it's sent as.
column2: ! name: e //! about: lo descrivono, //! command: Il suo titolo = function aggiunge un comando, e //! on_open:, //! on_save:, //! on_send: o //! on_run: function indica cosa viene eseguito e quando. In on_send, send_device() indica il dispositivo e set_send_name("NAME") cambia il nome con cui viene inviato.
